entries.label: The hollow alliance
entries.summary: The transatlantic alliance is weaker and less relevant than in decades.
entries.quote: The trans-Atlantic partnership has been the world's most important alliance for nearly 70 years, but it's now weaker, and less relevant, than at any point in decades.

entries.label: Closed Europe
entries.summary: Inequality, refugees, terrorism and grassroots pressure challenge the EU.
entries.quote: Divisions in Europe will reach a critical point, and a combination of inequality, refugees, terrorism, and grassroots political pressures pose an unprecedented challenge to the European Union.

entries.label: The China footprint
entries.summary: China becomes an influential rule-maker abroad.
entries.quote: Beijing is moving from free-rider and rule-taker to ever more influential rule-maker
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: ISIS and “friends”
entries.summary: The threat from ISIS and other jihadist groups increases.
entries.quote: The threat from ISIS—as well as Al Qaeda, Boko Haram, and others—will increase
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: Saudi Arabia
entries.summary: Saudi Arabia is more isolated than in decades.
entries.quote: Saudi Arabia is more geopolitically isolated than at any other point in the last several decades
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: The rise of technologists
entries.summary: Politically active technologists undermine government policies.
entries.quote: As technologists grow more politically active, their influence will undermine government policies
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: Unpredictable leaders
entries.summary: Erratic leaders make international politics volatile.
entries.quote: An unusually wide constellation of leaders known for erratic behavior will make international politics exceptionally volatile this year.
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the PDF section.

entries.label: Brazil
entries.summary: Rousseff makes concessions to her base to avoid impeachment amid recession.
entries.quote: To ensure the support she needs in congress to stave off an impeachment, Rousseff will have to make concessions to her leftist base
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: Not enough elections
entries.summary: Few elections leave frustration to spill into street protests in emerging markets.
entries.quote: There is an increased likelihood of street protests in Brazil, South Africa, and other emerging markets
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: Turkey
entries.summary: Economic populism undermines reform of Turkey's vulnerabilities.
entries.quote: The government's focus on currying favor with voters through economic populism will undermine attempts to address the country's structural economic vulnerabilities
entries.note: Quote is the PDF section headline.

entries.label: US elections
entries.summary: Eurasia Group does not expect a US president who closes the country to Muslims.
entries.quote: US voters aren't going to elect a president who will close the country to Muslims.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

entries.label: China: no hard landing
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects no Chinese hard landing and stable politics.
entries.quote: China's economy isn't headed for a hard landing, and its politics will remain stable.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

entries.label: Asia geopolitics
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects strong Asian leaders to limit conflict risk.
entries.note: Landing-page summary credits Abe, Modi and Xi with keeping Asia's main powers focused on reform. Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

notes: Landing page lists labels; headline quotes for risks 3-10 are from the PDF section headlines (spacing repaired from PDF text extraction). The PDF also prints under 'US elections' that Eurasia Group did not think Trump could be the Republican nominee or beat Clinton.
